newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan offers electric car for lease in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Nissan offers electric car for lease in Japan.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had started marketing its Prairie Joy EV electric station wagon in Japan to government agencies and major firms such as electric power companies.
The vehicle cannot be bought, but will be leased under a three-year contract for 320,000 yen per month.
Nissan hopes to lease 30 of the Prairie Joys a year. The station wagon, powered by lithium-ion batteries, can travel more than 200 km in urban traffic on one charge, Nissan said.
The battery, developed with Sony Corp, is three times more dense than common lead-acid batteries, Nissan said.
Nissan added it plans to introduce another lithium-ion battery-powered car in California in early 1998.
